text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: tenant=\"sirocco\" in VPC dedicated pool=\"eu-west-2-ded-23\" is receiving elevated 429s. Spike started ~2025-07-05T12:14:00Z. Current 5m error rate: 18% (baseline <1%). Paging on-call: @Maya Chen. Runbook: /runbooks/vpc-tenant-429. Link: https://internal.incidents/1789994321

incident-bot: Sample probe logs:
```
[12:14:02Z] request_id=abcd1234 tenant=sirocco resp=429 rate_limit=tenant_rate_limit
[12:14:03Z] request_id=abcd1235 tenant=sirocco resp=429 route=/v1/generate model=redwood-large
[12:14:04Z] request_id=abcd1236 tenant=sirocco resp=200 route=/v1/embed
```

Maya Chen: Oncall Maya here, looking. @Aj Patel can you join? I'll escalate if we need capacity changes.

Aj Patel: I'm on it. Pulling metrics from the pool. Quick glance: QPS for sirocco jumped 6x at 12:13, KV cache miss rate up ~40%, but GPUs aren't saturated (avg GPU util 62%). Suspect a request fanout or retry loop on client side. Grabbed a sample curl that returns 429:
```bash
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-large\",\"prompt\":\"hi\"}' \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
# -> HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
```

Samir Kapoor: I can apply a targeted exception (emergency lift) for tenant sirocco to avoid customer downtime while we triage. Options: 
- short emergency override (30m) to bump tenant token allowance and concurrent reqs
- reweight dedicated pool to allocate extra slots to eu-west-2-ded-23
I need AE sign-off for contract-exempt overrides. Proposed: emergency +2x concurrency and +3x token allowance for 30m.

Nora Velasquez: I just pinged Sirocco's CTO (in-thread DM). Sirocco's ops confirmed they are receiving 429s and asked for immediate relief. They requested 60m, but we can start with 30m while we confirm root cause. I approve the 30m emergency lift on behalf of renewals/product — will get signed confirmation after. :thumbsup:

Samir Kapoor: Executing emergency override now (admin CLI):
```bash
redwood-admin tenant override apply --tenant sirocco \\
  --concurrency-mult 2.0 --token-mult 3.0 --ttl 30m --reason \"Emergency customer relief: unexpected 429s\"
# output:
# OVERRIDE_ID=OVR-178999-01
# status=applied
```

incident-bot: Change executed: OVERRIDE_ID=OVR-178999-01, TTL=30m, applied to eu-west-2-ded-23. Audit link: https://internal.audit/OVR-178999-01

Aj Patel: Confirming effects — within 90s error rate dropped. 5m error rate now 1.2%. Live metrics:
```
pre-override: qps=1200 429_rate=18%
post-override: qps=1260 429_rate=1.2%
GPU avg util: 62% -> 64% (stable)
```
No downstream overload detected. Leaving short-term override in place while we watch.

Leo Grant: I added a temporary routing rule to divert new requests from high-cost variant to a cheaper fallback model `redwood-medium-1` for tenant sirocco. Expect slight quality delta but reduces per-token processing. Applied via routing CLI:
```bash
redwood-route update --tenant sirocco --fallback-model redwood-medium-1 --priority 10 --ttl 30m
```

Maya Chen: Handing off monitoring to Aj Patel — I need to clear the pager for other incidents. Aj, please keep this channel updated every 10m until TTL expiry. I'm removing myself from the page.

Aj Patel: Handoff ACK. I'll monitor and escalate to Samir if we see resource pressure. Creating internal follow-ups: INC-178999-A (change/rollback ticket) and PM-178999 (postmortem).

Nora Velasquez: Sirocco ops DM'd back: \"service restored, thanks, please confirm when override is revoked.\" I'll coordinate contract amendment request and make sure we capture this as a billable exception.

Samir Kapoor: Follow-ups I'm filing: INFRA-5952 (investigate KV cache miss pattern + prefix-heavy traffic), INFRA-5953 (add tenant circuit-breaker tunables), INFRA-5954 (improve alerting thresholds for sudden-tenant-qps). Also will include a runbook appendix for emergency overrides.

incident-bot: NOTE: emergency override OVR-178999-01 will auto-revoke at TTL expiry (2025-07-05T12:44:00Z). Manual rollback command:
```bash
redwood-admin tenant override revoke --id OVR-178999-01
```

Aj Patel: 12:21 UTC status update: 5m error rate stable at 1.0%, no spike in other tenants. Keeping watch.

Maya Chen: thx all — unpaged. :pray:

Aj Patel: 12:44 UTC — override auto-revoked (OVR-178999-01). Post-rollback check: 5m error rate remains low (0.9%). Closing the pager. Will include timeline and action items in PM-178999.

Nora Velasquez: Customer confirms no further impact. Scheduling exec follow-up and contract exception paperwork.

incident-bot: Incident pager closed. Actions: assign PM-178999 to incident owners (Aj, Samir, Leo), notify SRE oncall if pattern recurs, attach audit OVR-178999-01.

Maya Chen: Great job team. We'll review in the postmortem and decide on permanent quota adjustments if needed. :white_check_mark:
